dvids.title: U.S. Forces Enforce Blockade
dvids.desc: U.S. forces completed a verification boarding aboard Comoros-flagged M/T Charminar in the Arabian Sea, and the tanker is now continuing its journey, July 25, 2026. CENTCOM forces disabled Mozambique-flagged M/T Lavine in the Gulf of Oman, July 24, 2026. (U.S. Central Command video)
